drivingQuestion: Which properties inside a walled city, and which houses built into its wall, are governed by the law of houses of walled cities?
outcomeNote: a mishna recording two tannaitic disputes without argument

segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ כׇּל שֶׁהוּא לִפְנִים מִן הַחוֹמָה — הֲרֵי הוּא כְּבָתֵּי עָרֵי חוֹמָה, חוּץ מִן הַשָּׂדוֹת. רַבִּי מֵאִיר אוֹמֵר: אַף הַשָּׂדוֹת. בַּיִת הַבָּנוּי בַּחוֹמָה — רַבִּי יְהוּדָה אוֹמֵר: אֵינוֹ כְּבָתֵּי עָרֵי חוֹמָה. רַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן אוֹמֵר: כּוֹתֶל הַחִיצוֹן הִיא חוֹמָתוֹ.
segments.en: «MISHNA» The halakhic status of «any» area «that is» located «within the» city «wall is like» that «of the houses of walled cities» in terms of its redemption, «except for the fields» located therein. «Rabbi Meir says: Even the fields» are included in this category. With regard to «a house that is built in the wall» itself, «Rabbi Yehuda says:» Its halakhic status «is not like» that «of the houses of walled cities. Rabbi Shimon says: The outer wall» of the house «is» considered the city «wall,» and therefore it has the status of a house in a walled city.

moves.summary: everything inside the wall is like a house of a walled city, except the fields
moves.about: whether the fields lying inside the city wall share the status of houses of walled cities for redemption

moves.summary: R' Meir includes even the fields
moves.about: whether a house built into the city wall itself has the status of a house of a walled city

moves.cueHe: בית הבנוי בחומה — רבי יהודה אומר
moves.summary: a new case: a house built into the wall is not like the houses of walled cities

moves.cueHe: רבי שמעון אומר: כותל החיצון היא חומתו
moves.summary: R' Shimon: its outer wall is the city wall, so it is included

edges.about: whether the fields lying inside the city wall share the status of houses of walled cities for redemption

edges.cueHe: רבי יהודה אומר: אינו כבתי ערי חומה. רבי שמעון אומר: כותל החיצון היא חומתו
edges.about: whether a house built into the city wall itself has the status of a house of a walled city
